outcome_evidence: The spoon is grasped and lifted from the table in frames 30–36 (wrist_left, wrist_right), transferred between grippers in frames 59–69 (ceiling, wrist_left, wrist_right), and carried over the blue box in frames 78–90 (ceiling, wrist_right).
